prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1146; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you're comfortable continuing?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe where you were when the collision occurred.

A: I was on the highway in Katy, heading east in the right lane. Traffic was moving fairly steadily. I needed to move over to the left lane because my exit was coming up.

Q: What happened when you changed lanes?

A: I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder. I didn't see anything right beside me, so I started to move over. Then I heard a loud scraping noise and felt my car get pushed toward the median.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. It came up in my blind spot, I think. By the time I saw it, it was already touching my front passenger side.

Q: Did you brake or swerve?

A: I braked and tried to correct back into my lane. The car spun a little, but I got it stopped on the shoulder.

Q: Were you injured?

A: I hit my head on the side window and I'm still having headaches. I also felt dizzy and sensitive to light for a few hours afterward. My doctor said it looks like a concussion.

Q: Have you been seeing a physician since the accident?

A: Yes, I've had two follow-up visits and I'm following a rest plan. I've been told to limit screen time and avoid driving when I feel symptoms coming on.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I was being careful. I signaled and checked before moving. I'd like the other driver's information on record.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
